name: daisyUI
summary: Free Tailwind CSS component library: 68 CSS components, semantic color names, themes and no JavaScript.
description: daisyUI is a pure-CSS plugin that adds semantic class names (btn, card, navbar, drawer, modal ...) and part/modifier classes to Tailwind CSS, so elements need far fewer utility classes. It ships 68 components, 600+ utility classes, semantic color names (primary, secondary, accent, neutral, info, success, warning, error) and CSS-variable themes including dark mode, plus a theme generator. v5 requires Tailwind CSS 4; framework guides cover React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Laravel and 30+ setups.
contains: semantic class names: btn, card, navbar, drawer, modal, tabs, table, toast ...
semantic colors: primary, secondary, accent, neutral, info, success, warning, error
themes via CSS variables incl. light and dark; theme generator
pure CSS, no JS dependency; 30+ framework setup guides
